reviews.title: Wow, really BAD
reviews.text: This app just seriously told me not to take a medical professionals advice and was very egotistical about it! Also, I out of every maybe, 10 readings is accurate. That’s it. It’s always picking up on energy around you. Not yours. Don’t get sucked in. It can be addictive and for nothing.

reviews.title: System errors no response from cs
reviews.text: i enjoy the app but seems to he alot of system errors. When you try for help no one responds.

reviews.title: Too much ads
reviews.text: It keeps getting more and more adds! It is disgusting! As users this app doesn’t leave us any other choice than to delete! Why am I have to watch 2 videos when I opened my reading? Moreover why am I keep have to watch more and more videos especially when there is a question in my reading? You people are absolutely disgusting!!

reviews.title: A scam
reviews.text: Everything is too expensive, you wish to ask a question? pay 3$ for ai generated answer. You want a better interpretation? Pay 9$. Sometimes they charge 20$ and the crazy thing is, is that it’s all AI, you could easily get better coffee readings on Reddit for FREE from real human beings, or on chatGPT with no cost at all. Useless app, wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.
